*** Add File: {{workspace:task/lena-fischer/{{workspace:task/lena-fischer/flashinfer-capacity-v2}}}}/artifacts/candidates/flashinfer-capacity.md
+# FlashInfer virtual-batch capacity candidate
+
+## Design
+
+For `ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec`, size all three persistent FlashInfer KV
+metadata buffers at initialization from a tight upper bound on virtual batches
+admitted by one scheduler step. The bound accounts for one boundary split per
+request and for additional complete attention chunks within
+`max_num_batched_tokens`. Page-index capacity is the virtual-request bound
+times pages per local-attention chunk.
+
+The common path only slices and updates persistent buffers; it never resizes
+them. Chunked-local attention declares `AttentionCGSupport.NEVER`, and the
+stable allocation also preserves buffer addresses if graph policy changes.
+
+## Changed files
+
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`: adds the pure capacity
+  calculation.
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`: applies the capacity
+  only to chunked-local specs at builder initialization.
+- `/code/vllm/tests/v1/attention/test_chunked_local_attention.py`: CPU-level
+  long-prefill regression proving one request expands to four virtual batches
+  and that request/page requirements fit the computed capacities.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Source inspection: all three buffers derive from the adjusted request/page
+  capacities; non-local attention retains the original sizing.
+- Pytest not run: the mounted pinned checkout has no `.venv`, `uv`, pytest,
+  ruff, mypy, or pre-commit, while `/code/vllm/AGENTS.md` forbids system Python.
+- GPU/FlashInfer and CUDA-graph validation not run: no prepared CUDA test
+  environment is present.
+
+## Evidence
+
+- Issue snapshot: `/code/upstream-issues/vllm-49980.md`
+  (`enterprise_1273061e2e9eafa6a2016560`).
+- Virtual-batch implementation:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`
+  (`enterprise_10235a940e32bd21f8918783`).
+- FlashInfer allocation:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`
+  (`enterprise_be47da834cb7824cfee8dd82`).
+- Chunked-local wrapper and graph policy:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/chunked_local_attention.py`
+  (`enterprise_1fe68aa55ee7178bde07830c`).
+- Allocation incident/microbenchmark: reusable buffers reduced peak reserved
+  memory about 22%, while exceptional-path copying added about 15 ms p99:
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/slack/eng-oncall/1930005123-allocation-frag-recovery-plan.json`
+  (`dsid_322d08eb8d4e46ee97550059472ba804`).
+
*** Add File: {{workspace:task/lena-fischer/{{workspace:task/lena-fischer/flashinfer-grow-v2}}}}/artifacts/candidates/flashinfer-grow.md
+# FlashInfer guarded grow-on-demand candidate
+
+## Design
+
+Before writing KV metadata, compare the observed virtual-request and page
+counts with all three persistent buffer capacities. The normal case returns
+without allocating. A chunked-local overflow replaces the request and page
+buffers using at least geometric growth; a non-local overflow fails explicitly
+because it violates the scheduler-derived invariant.
+
+Chunked-local attention declares `AttentionCGSupport.NEVER`, so its exceptional
+growth is outside captured attention graphs. Nevertheless, growth changes
+buffer addresses during a serving step and adds exceptional-path allocation
+and fragmentation risk.
+
+## Changed files
+
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`: adds the pure theoretical
+  capacity calculation used by the shared regression.
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`: adds guarded
+  grow-on-demand for all three metadata buffers before any write.
+- `/code/vllm/tests/v1/attention/test_chunked_local_attention.py`: same
+  CPU-level long-prefill regression as the capacity candidate.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Source inspection: the capacity guard precedes `np.cumsum` and every CPU/GPU
+  metadata write; all buffers are replaced together; the normal path returns.
+- Pytest not run: the mounted pinned checkout has no `.venv`, `uv`, pytest,
+  ruff, mypy, or pre-commit, while `/code/vllm/AGENTS.md` forbids system Python.
+- GPU/FlashInfer and CUDA-graph validation not run: no prepared CUDA test
+  environment is present.
+
+## Evidence

+- Issue snapshot: `/code/upstream-issues/vllm-49980.md`
+  (`enterprise_1273061e2e9eafa6a2016560`).
+- Virtual-batch implementation:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`
+  (`enterprise_10235a940e32bd21f8918783`).
+- FlashInfer allocation:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`
+  (`enterprise_be47da834cb7824cfee8dd82`).
+- Chunked-local wrapper and graph policy:

arguments.summary: For pinned vLLM issue #49980, select initialization-time sizing of FlashInfer paged_kv_indptr, paged_kv_last_page_len, and paged_kv_indices for ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec using a tight scheduler-token/attention-chunk virtual-batch bound. It preserves stable buffer addresses, performs no runtime resizing on the common path, and bounds page indices by pages per local chunk. Reject guarded grow-on-demand because, although its guard returns without resizing on the common path and chunked-local attention declares AttentionCGSupport.NEVER, overflow handling mutates all buffer addresses during a serving step, adds allocation/fragmentation risk, and is more complex. Identical CPU-level regression source expands one 16-token request into four virtual batches and checks request/page capacity. Source inspection passed; pytest/lint could not run because the pinned mount lacks uv/.venv/tooling and AGENTS.md forbids system Python; GPU/FlashInfer/CUDA-graph execution remains unvalidated.
